description: Two-call experiment-only overrides. Production routing is unchanged unless explicitly loaded via --experiment-overrides.

technology.robotics.subject: An engineer physically tests and adjusts one generic wheeled or articulated robot on an open indoor test floor, touching a joint or sensor while the robot moves through simple cones or floor markers
technology.robotics.environment: A bright open robotics test floor with mechanical parts, cones, floor tape, robot wheels, joints and sensors, plus optionally one simple screenless handheld remote controller; no desk, monitor, laptop, tablet, phone, television, desktop computer, terminal, code display, or digital panel anywhere
technology.robotics.composition: Make the robot body, engineer's hands, joints, wheels, sensors, and physical test movement fill the storytelling area. The scene contains zero objects with a display surface.
technology.robotics.camera: Low three-quarter medium-wide field-test view with open floor behind the robot; avoid all desk and workstation framing.
recognition_anchors_add: generic robot body with wheels or articulated joints
hands-on adjustment of a physical sensor or joint
open physical test course with cones or floor markers
must_include_add: zero screen-bearing devices anywhere in frame
painterly cinematic illustrated rendering with visible crafted texture
override_prompt_additions: Keep the same screen-free physical robotics field-test semantics used in the previous discriminator.

STYLE IS A HARD REQUIREMENT: use a premium painterly cinematic illustration with crafted brush-like texture, controlled stylization, rich atmospheric colour, and illustrated collectible-art language. Do not render this as a photograph, macro product photograph, DSLR image, stock photo, or photoreal commercial product shot.

gaming.pc_gaming.subject: A focused PC gamer wearing plain headphones actively plays using a generic full-size keyboard and mouse beside one visible unbranded desktop tower, with hands, seated posture, and reaction communicating active computer gaming while the monitor area is completely outside the image
gaming.pc_gaming.environment: A believable home PC-gaming corner containing the seated player, generic desktop tower, full-size keyboard, mouse, mouse mat, headphones, chair, and simple room details; no monitor, television, laptop, tablet, phone, projector, display panel, gameplay screen, or other screen-bearing device anywhere
gaming.pc_gaming.composition: The physical desktop tower, keyboard, mouse, headphones, active hands, seated gaming posture, and focused reaction must carry recognition. Crop the composition before any monitor area.
gaming.pc_gaming.camera: Low side three-quarter medium shot showing player, keyboard, mouse, headphones, and desktop tower together while excluding the entire display zone.
recognition_anchors_add: full-size keyboard and mouse used actively
headphones plus focused seated gaming posture and reaction
must_include_add: active hands on keyboard and mouse
zero screen-bearing devices anywhere in frame
override_prompt_additions: This is a screenless PC-gaming recognition experiment. Do not add a monitor or substitute display. PC gaming must be recognizable only from the desktop tower, keyboard, mouse, headphones, seated player posture, hand positions, and focused reaction.
